title: Pure projective tilting modules associated with a special ring and Goresntein properties
summary: In this paper, we study pure-projective tilting modules and related classes of rings. We introduce the notion of a pure-tilting hereditary ring, namely, a ring over which every ideal is pure-projective tilting, and investigate its structural properties. We prove that a ring R is a pure-tilting hereditary ring if and only if R is hereditary noetherian over a von Neumann regular ring R. In the commutative case, we show that R is a pure one-tilting hereditary ring precisely when R is hereditary noetherian.
